name: Kerbal Space Program
short_description: Build rockets from parts and fly little green Kerbals to space with real orbital physics.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Build rockets from parts and fly little green Kerbals to space with real orbital physics.

identity.core_loop: Build a rocket, launch, crash, learn, reach orbit, land on the Mun.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Navball and orbit map are precise overlays; the Kerbals' faces show fear and joy (spatial).

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Learning real physics by building and failing. Kerbals' faces are a perfect wordless gauge.
